methods.displayName: Prepare servery meat pies at the Hosidius Mess

start.instruction: Prepare and serve meat pies with the room's supplies. Recheck before expanding the batch; no outside ingredient acquisition or disposal is modeled.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted level 20 required to prepare servery meat pies.

freeInventorySlots.description: Four ordinary empty positions for a small self-contained preparation cycle; maximum-throughput inventory clearing is not assumed.

stopConditions.description: Re-evaluate at the servery pineapple-pizza tier or the selected goal target, whichever comes first.

costs.assumptions: Travel time is unestimated. The room supplies the modeled ingredients; four free positions scope a small cycle and do not claim maximum throughput.

methods.reason: A supply-free UIM Cooking path when ordinary inventory space is available.

requirements.description: Four ordinary empty positions for the scoped small cycle.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Editorial value for a verified small self-contained cycle; published maximum rates assume much more space and are not imported.

sources.notes: The UIM guide identifies Hosidius Mess as a no-supply, no-money method and gives meat pies from level 20; large empty inventories are an efficiency recommendation.
Activity page reviewed for the servery cupboard, preparation loop and serving location.

start.contact: Carried grapes and jugs of water
start.instruction: Combine one exact carried grape with one exact carried jug of water. Wait for fermentation and re-evaluate; no future ingredients, banking or unnoting are assumed.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted level 35 required to make unfermented wine.

freeInventorySlots.description: No additional empty position: two observed input positions become one unfermented-wine position.

consumes.description: One exact carried jug of water.

produces.basis: One unfermented wine per combination; fermentation outcome is assessed later.

stopConditions.description: Re-evaluate at the current RFD unboosted Cooking target.
Recheck when carried grapes are exhausted.
Recheck when carried jugs of water are exhausted.

costs.assumptions: Only one carried combination is modeled. Fermentation takes time and can fail below level 68; no hourly rate or guaranteed Cooking XP is claimed.

methods.reason: Turns exact carried ingredients into a compact bounded Cooking action without assuming a bank or resupply.

requirements.description: One exact carried jug of water.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Editorial value for a verified carried combination. Failure chance below 68 and the later fermentation boundary prevent an XP-rate claim.

sources.notes: The UIM guide identifies wine as an easier carried-input alternative at higher levels; its noted-item and death-storage route is excluded.
Level 35, one grape plus one jug of water, the unfermented intermediate, fermentation delay and failure below level 68 were reviewed.
Exact grape, jug-of-water and unfermented-wine identities use pinned public gameval constants.

methods.displayName: Prepare servery pineapple pizzas at the Hosidius Mess

start.instruction: Prepare and serve pineapple pizzas with the room's supplies. Use a small cycle and recheck capacity; Humidify and maximum-space layouts are optional efficiency assumptions.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted level 65 required to prepare servery pineapple pizzas.

freeInventorySlots.description: Six ordinary empty positions for a conservative small pizza cycle; a maximum-throughput empty inventory is not assumed.

stopConditions.description: Re-evaluate at the current RFD unboosted Cooking target.

costs.assumptions: Travel time is unestimated. The room supplies ingredients. Humidify and extensive inventory clearing remain optional and earn no default benefit.

methods.reason: A faster self-contained late-RFD Cooking option that does not assume carried raw food or shop acquisition.

requirements.description: Six ordinary empty positions for the scoped small cycle.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Editorial value for a verified small cycle. Published rates assume high focus, much more space and Humidify; none is claimed here.

sources.notes: The UIM guide identifies level-65 servery pineapple pizzas as the faster Mess tier and states that Humidify improves speed but is not required.
Activity page reviewed for level, supplied ingredients and the serving loop.
